issues.description: The tensor-networks two-qubit gate factory is referred to as create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate in the problem statement and the solution, but the template defines a function named create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate. This identifier mismatch will confuse students (and cause tests/imports to fail) because the expected function name from the specification/tests is missing in the template.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template function create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate to create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate (and keep the same signature), or add a wrapper/alias named create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate that calls create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate. This will align the template with the problem specification and the solution/tests.
